item.title: [−1] Brent climbs to a near two-week high of about $106 on Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia
item.description:
A drone hit a tanker near Sohar, Oman, and Houthis can still hit Saudi tankers in the Red Sea. Brent eased to about $105.86 on Tuesday. Reverses Monday morning's dip to $103.

Metals, cement & chemicals: mild headwind (−1) — Crude-linked inputs

Why it matters: Attacks on Saudi Arabia threaten India's main non-Hormuz crude supplier and its Red Sea route, keeping the import bill and fuel costs high.

Market gauges: Fiscal & trade balance −2, Inflation outlook −1, Rupee −1

Confidence: high · horizon: weeks

item.title: [−1] India's LNG costs surge to $26.4 per mmBtu; government prioritises city gas
item.description:
The Hormuz crisis threatens South Asian LNG supply, and India is directing gas first to city distribution. Follows a cut in Qatari supply. Escalating.

Metals, cement & chemicals: mild headwind (−1) — Gas-using industries

Why it matters: Pricier LNG raises costs for fertiliser plants, ceramics and gas power, adds to the subsidy bill and feeds inflation.

Market gauges: Fiscal & trade balance −1, Inflation outlook −1

Confidence: medium · horizon: weeks
